messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Portuguese, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Portuguese line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Não homem homem já fui, e meus pais foram lombardos, mantuanos por pátria ambos.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (truth‑conditions) | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (EN) | Status | |-------------|-------------------------------------------|--------------------|------------------------|--------| | Rispuosemi | “He answered me” (predicate verb) | *(none)* | *(none)* | **MISSING** | | Non | Negation particle | Não | “not” | OK | | omo (1) | Predicate nominal “man” (negated) | homem | “man” | OK | | omo (2) | Predicate nominal “man” (affirmed) | homem | “man” | OK | | già | Temporal adverb “once” | já | “already / once” | OK | | fui | Copular verb “I was” | fui | “I was” | OK | | e | Coordinating conjunction “and” | e | “and” | OK | | li | Definite article “the” (marks *parenti*) | *(omitted)* | *(none)* | **UNNECESSARY** | | parenti | Noun “parents” | pais | “parents” | OK | | miei | Possessive adjective “my” | meus | “my” | OK | | furon | Copular verb “were” | foram | “were” | OK | | lombardi | Predicate nominal “Lombards” | lombardos | “Lombards” | OK | | mantoani | Predicate nominal “Mantuans” | mantuanos | “Mantuans” | OK | | per | Preposition “by” (basis of identification) | por | “by” | OK | | patrïa | Noun “country” (criterion of identity) | pátria | “country” | OK | | ambedui | Quantifier “both” (applies to speaker + parents) | ambos | “both” | OK |
---
### Items to Review - **MISSING:** *Rispuosemi* – the reporting verb “He answered me” was omitted in the Portuguese rendering. - **UNNECESSARY:** *li* – the Italian definite article “the” is not required in Portuguese; the translation correctly omitted it.
All other lexical items are present, correctly translated, and agree in gender/number with the Portuguese target.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Portuguese script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Portuguese text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 67: - Original: Não homem homem já fui, - Issue: MISSING reporting verb - Corrected: Ele respondeu‑me: «Não homem, homem já fui, - Line 68: - Original: e meus pais foram lombardos, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 69: - Original: mantuanos por pátria ambos. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` Ele respondeu‑me: «Não homem, homem já fui, e meus pais foram lombardos, mantuanos por pátria ambos. ```
